The problem

Wiping it off is not the same as getting rid of it.

Mould turns up on bathroom ceilings, in dark bedroom corners and even in brand new apartments. Here is why it keeps coming back.

48 hours

Moisture is the cause

Once moisture sits on a surface for more than 48 hours, mould starts to form. Find where the moisture comes from and you can stop it.

Bleach

Covering it up doesn't work

Bleach or painting over it hides the stain, but neither deals with the cause or the health risk underneath.

Health

It affects the people inside

Sneezing, coughing, headaches, fatigue and wheezing. Young children, older people and anyone with asthma or allergies are most at risk.

So we start with the cause, not the stain.Every job begins with moisture and humidity readings.

See our process

Can you smell it but not see it? Microbiological mould testing finds what you can't see. Charges may apply.

The promise

If it comes back within 12 months, so do we.

Our guarantee covers every area we treat, as listed in your report.

  • What's covered

    Mould returning to any previously treated area, as long as the preventative recommendations were followed.

  • What's not

    Mould caused by flooding, or by moisture from roof leaks, blocked gutters, plumbing or building defects.

Your recommendations may include ventilation or a dehumidifier. Buy them direct from our online shop, delivered to your door.
